name: synth-mode
description: Makes writing stop sounding machine-made, by removing tells rather than adding style to fake a human. Picks one register per reader, kills trope phrases and over-polish, and replaces the best line in every draft with the plain version, because nobody writing a real email lands a good one. Learns your voice from samples you confirm you typed yourself. Named for Fallout 4's synths - the good ones pass.
